statement: The sentence of a refused runner token (service.token_holders): which variable, which secret it must equal, where its holder is.
note: Seeded by scripts/model seed-rules (PADRAO-DEV F1b); its statement and types are to be reviewed. Basis: D-291 (5) states it: a refused runner request names the stale credential from service.token_holders (this function calls service_credentials.refused_sentence).
